topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Stepping into the school, memories flutter like old leaves, settling around me. There, through the door of the classroom, it's her—Mrs. Everett. Her smile is a familiar sun, unchanged by the years, her eyes crinkling at the corners as she greets my child with the same warmth that once wrapped around my own young worries and dreams. The walls, adorned with student art and alphabets, whisper a timeless reassurance. Here, where the chalkboard still holds the echoes of lessons learned and shared, a thread connects us, past and present, weaving a tapestry of shared beginnings. My child’s laughter mingles with the steady rhythm of her voice, and in this moment, the cycle feels right, infinitely right.
